_evidence: 0x00556e7c (cl = 0x11 path): 'add ebx,edx; cmp ebx,[0x866eb8]; jb' keeps the record ebx + ax*0x160 when it lies below the ring end [0x866eb8], else wraps it back by [0x866ebc]. With ebx = records 0..29 and the word offset ax = 0..31 (spec), the sum spans records 0..60, while ring_008943a0 draws the end only from records 4..26, so the in-range (jb taken) side was rare. The end is drawn here as a record-aligned pointer over records 4..64 (compose after ring_008943a0+ring_0043d30c), so the sum lies below and at/above it about equally often. Every resulting record stays inside the 432-record array (at most record 60 before, record 60 - 8 after the wrap), so the byte store +0x17 never leaves .data. The mode byte [0x86857c] ('cmp byte [0x86857c],2; je') is 2 in most cases (0/1/3/0xff otherwise) so the record paths run often.
